summary: Dense apartment street, homes within 9 m, very steep, signed no parking.
reasons: No Parking and No Stopping signs

best_section.where: Prince Street south kerb beside the white apartment block

drivers.seclusion: Apartments 8 m away at 39 m, houses 9 m at the start; flats and a kindergarten close on all sides.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; cars park along the kerb, but signs ban parking and stopping.
drivers.traffic: Residential street at a busy junction with steady local traffic.
drivers.convention: Signed No Parking Any Time and No Stopping Any Time; parked cars are visible nearby.
